meta.title: EMBERFALL
meta.subtitle: A Kingdom Under a Dying Sun
intro: For a thousand years the kingdom of Vael lived beneath two suns. One was the ordinary sun. The other was Aurun, the Dawnfather: a god who hung in the sky like a coin of gold, and whose light healed the sick, ripened the barley, and kept the dead where they were laid.

Twelve years ago, his light began to stutter. Three years ago, his heart cracked. Four burning Embers fell across Vael, and from every place his light failed, the Pall came creeping: grey ash, fine as breath, in which the dead do not stay dead.
The king is gone. The kingdom is three kingdoms now, each arguing over the same question while the light goes out.
You died last week. Fever, they said. They built you a good pyre.
search_fail: You search carefully. Dust, ash, and the faint smell of old smoke. Nothing more.
You turn over what can be turned over. The world keeps its secrets, for now.
Nothing. Though you have the uneasy feeling that something nearby has been searching, too.
You find a dead beetle, curled like a tiny fist. That's all.
